biggest_catch: This is not free money: you must risk your own capital by trading $100-$10,000+ on Coinbase Advanced within 14 days of becoming trade-eligible. Trading incurs Coinbase's fees and spreads, and crypto bought with your own money can lose value. Coinbase's own terms warn your reward 'may increase or decrease in value after it's deposited into your account,' and the offer is 'limited time' and revocable at any time without notice.
catches: Requires signing up through someone's referral link (or after 365 days of no Advanced activity) — not a plain signup bonus anyone gets for registering directly.
Only trades on Coinbase Advanced count; purchases on Coinbase Simple Trade or Coinbase Prime do not count toward the $100+ qualifying volume.
The invitee's qualifying trading volume must be completed within 14 days of becoming trade-eligible, or no reward is paid.
Payouts are tiered: $100-$5,000 volume → $5; $5,000-$10,000 → $20; over $10,000 → $50 — you must trade over $10,000 to get the maximum $50.
The reward to the invitee is subject to change without notice; Coinbase can alter or revoke the program at any time, including revoking invitee rewards.
Cannot be combined with the Coinbase New User First Buy Spin The Wheel Incentive, Referral Program, or New User First Trade Promo Code.
Excluded: UK, Turkey, Philippines, and Canada residents; void where prohibited.
Coinbase includes a spread in the price when you buy or sell — trading $100+ costs more than $100 in effective terms.

c3.evidence: No participation fee disclosed; the real cost is trading $100+ of the user's own money within 14 days (fees/spreads apply).

c4.evidence: Concrete money fact: invitee earns $5 / $20 / $50 based on exact 14-day trading-volume tiers (>$100-$5,000 / >$5,000-$10,000 / >$10,000), paid in USDC per Coinbase's referral signup page, added within 24 hours after the 14-day period.

eligibility: New users who sign up via a referral link (or existing Coinbase users with no Advanced activity in the prior 365 days); must complete qualifying trading volume within 14 days of becoming trade-eligible; trades must be on Coinbase Advanced only; excluded: UK, Turkey, Philippines, Canada; void where prohibited.

steps: Sign up for a new Coinbase account using someone's Coinbase Advanced referral link (purchases must be on Advanced; Simple Trade/Prime do not count).
Complete identity verification to become trade-eligible.

Trade at least $100 in spot (or perpetual futures) volume on Coinbase Advanced within 14 days of becoming trade-eligible (tiers: $100-$5,000 → $5; $5,000-$10,000 → $20; over $10,000 → $50, paid in USDC).
Receive the invitee reward in your Coinbase account within 24 hours after the 14-day period expires, provided the minimum volume was met.
timing: The invitee's reward will be added to their Coinbase account within 24 hours after the 14-day period's expiration, provided the minimum qualifying trading volume was met.
